适配 Claude Code 2.1.296：/effort 显示成可以点选的滑: Ready for Claude Code 2.1.296: /effort shows as a slider to click; command panels no longer pick up the input box; the sign-in card no longer stays after signing in.
决策页“接下来要做什么”可以语音输入；打开设置、展开决策卡更流畅（主题预览改用小: The decisions page's "what next" box takes dictation; settings and decision cards open more smoothly (small theme previews, no animations repainted every frame).
决策页点开的卡片（交付审查、审批、提问）不再透明，后面的卡片和输入框不会透出来。: A decision card opened on the decisions page (a review, an approval, a question) is no longer see-through: the cards and the box behind it stay hidden.
你发出的图片都能点开放大：消息里的、输入框上方等着发送的、决策页输入框里的。: Pictures you send open larger on a click: in a message, waiting above the message box, or in the decisions page box.
一轮做完的项目卡不再闪烁呼吸，改为稳定的彩色边框和柔光，直到你查看。: A project card whose round is done no longer pulses: it keeps a steady coloured edge and a soft glow until you look at it.
在终端里运行 codex update、claude --version 这类不: Running a command that is no conversation in the terminal, such as codex update or claude --version, shows its state in the reading view ("Updating Codex…") with its output, and no message box.
Windows 上新开的 Codex 能读懂之前的开发记忆了：交接和记忆文件改为: A newly started Codex on Windows now understands the earlier development memory: the handoff and memory files are UTF-8 with a byte order mark, so PowerShell no longer garbles Chinese in them.
SSH 项目里的 Claude Code 也能进入阅读视图，后来新开的 SSH: Claude Code in an SSH project opens the reading view too, also in SSH terminals opened later; its replies, model and effort show.
回复里的 Markdown 代码块（比如“内容如下”展示的文件内容）直接排好版显: A Markdown block in a reply (a file's content shown "as follows") is laid out right there; "Source" shows the text it was written in.
Codex 请求修改文件或授予权限时，阅读视图也会弹出选框让你选择，不再只有执行: When Codex asks to edit files or for more permissions, the reading view shows the choice too, not only when it asks to run a command.
Codex 0.162 修改的文件在步骤里显示文件名，下方出现文件卡片，不再显示: Files Codex 0.162 edits are named in its steps and shown as cards below them, instead of the raw patch.
点开放大的图片可以右键“复制图片”，直接粘贴到别处。: A picture enlarged in its popup has "Copy image" on its right-click menu, to paste anywhere.
SSH 项目里粘贴图片，输入框只留你打的字，不再出现服务器上的图片路径；图片显示: Pasting a picture in an SSH project leaves the message box with your words alone, no path on the server; the picture shows above the box and goes with the message.
Claude 工作时，阅读视图里的标记像 Claude Code 终端一样变换形: While Claude works, its mark in the reading view changes shape as in Claude Code's terminal, visibly moving over Remote Desktop too; every animation follows the Motion setting.
用 Ctrl+Shift+方向键切换项目，上下左右对应它们在 grid 里的位置: Ctrl+Shift and an arrow move between projects as they sit in the grid; in a box with text they still select by word.
斜杠命令（如 /fast）完成后弹窗不再转圈，显示结果或“已完成，没有输出”，按: Once a slash command such as /fast is done, its popup stops spinning and shows the result, or that it finished with no output, until Esc; if no result can be read after 10 seconds, it offers the terminal.
同一台服务器上的 SSH 终端共用一个连接，后面开的终端几乎立刻打开。: SSH terminals on one server share one connection, so the ones after the first open almost at once.
阅读视图的文字缩小到原来的 0.85 倍。: The reading view's text is 0.85 times its former size.

文件编辑区按 Ctrl+F 查找：所有匹配处都会标出，Enter / Shift: Ctrl+F in the file editor finds text: every match is marked, Enter and Shift+Enter move between them, and Esc returns to the text.
在阅读视图里连续执行 Codex 的 /status 等命令，弹窗每次都显示结果: Running a Codex command such as /status again and again from the reading view shows its result every time, not "finished with no output".
在终端里启动 Codex 或 Claude Code 后，这里显示它的模型路由、: Start Codex or Claude Code in the terminal to see its model route, context length and usage here.

活动栏改为显示模型路由、上下文长度和用量：用的是哪个接口和模型、上下文还剩多少、: The activity pane now shows the model route, context length and usage: which service and model are in use, how much context is left, the tokens this round and this conversation took, and for Codex the 5-hour and weekly limits.
Claude Code 新对话的第一条提问在阅读视图里不再排到回答下面。: In the reading view, the first prompt of a new Claude Code conversation no longer appears below its answer.

阅读视图改为时间轴：你的提问、助手的回答和每组操作都是左侧时间线上的一个节点，旁: The reading view is now a timeline: your messages, the agent's answers and each group of steps are nodes on a line down the left, with their times beside them.
活动栏显示 Claude Code 的 5 小时和每周额度；任务卡片高度固定，不: The activity pane shows Claude Code's 5-hour and weekly limits; the tasks card keeps its height, so the cards below no longer move.
Claude Code 干活时发的消息显示为「已送达，排队中」，不再被当成没送达: A message sent while Claude Code works shows as delivered and queued, never as undelivered.
Codex 的 /memories、/plugins 等界面在阅读视图里正常显示: Codex's /memories, /plugins and similar screens show properly in the reading view; typing right after a slash command is no longer interrupted by the choices it opens.
阅读视图时间轴上的节点改为镂空细圈：壁纸透过节点可见，图标和细圈用各自的颜色（你: The reading view's timeline nodes are hollow rings: the wallpaper shows through, with the ring and icon in each kind's colour (blue for you, orange for Claude, white for Codex, cyan for steps).
Claude Code 的节点标志改为清晰的矢量星芒，任何大小都不再模糊。: Claude Code's node mark is a crisp vector spark that stays sharp at any size.
阅读视图左右留白更均衡：左边的时间和节点更紧凑，右边留出更多空间，消息框和卡片左: The reading view is balanced left and right: the times and nodes on the left are tighter, the right has more room, and the message box lines up with the cards.
运行中的节点不再转圈：Claude 的星芒像 Claude Code 自己的 ✻: Running nodes no longer spin: Claude's spark blooms and draws back like Claude Code's own ✻, and other steps send out soft rings.
鼠标划过时间轴上的条目时，条目会轻快地跳一下；滚动时不会跳。: Items on the timeline hop when the pointer passes over them; they stay still while you scroll.
修复：在阅读视图里发消息（尤其是带截图或用语音说的长消息）时，可能误按 Esc: Fixed: sending a message in the reading view (especially one with a screenshot or a long dictated one) could press Esc, interrupting a working Claude Code, and say a command's dialog was still open.
在 HTML 页面里「复制图片」后，可以粘贴到微信、Word 等其他程序里。: Copy image in an HTML page now pastes into other programs, such as a chat app or Word.
时间轴更清晰：节点、竖线和运行中的标记去掉了光晕，边缘都是实线。: A crisper timeline: the nodes, the line and the running marks have no glow, every edge is hard.
决策页改为左右两栏：左边是标题、待你决定的事和输入框，右边是所有会话，上下对齐、: The decision page is two aligned columns: the headline, what waits for you and the input on the left, every session on the right, filling the window.
修复：Claude 工作时在阅读视图里打开 /usage、/config 等命令: Fixed: with Claude at work, Esc on a command such as /usage or /config in the reading view now closes its dialog in the terminal too, without interrupting Claude.
阅读视图左右边距一样宽：去掉左边的时间列，时间放在名字后面（如「你 18:39」: The reading view has equal margins left and right: the time column is gone, each time follows the name (as in "You 18:39"), and the cards line up with the message box.
同一分钟内的连续步骤不再重复显示时间，一组操作的时间写在它的胶囊后面。: Steps within the same minute no longer repeat the time; a group of tool calls shows its time after its pill.
活动栏固定在窗口里，不再上下滚动：任务卡片自动让出空间，窗口较矮时其余卡片排得更: The activity pane stays fixed in the window and never scrolls: the tasks card makes room, and in a shorter window the other cards sit tighter.
阅读视图和输入框排成一列：头像和输入框左边对齐，卡片和输入框右边对齐，左右留白一: The reading view and the message box form one column: the avatars line up with its left edge, the cards with its right, equal margins on both sides; each time follows the name (as in "You 18:39").
语音输入完成后，文字先在输入框里显示半秒再发送；这半秒内打字或按 Esc 可以取: After dictation, the words show in the message box for half a second before they are sent; typing or Esc in that half second cancels the send.
阅读视图按机器人回合分层，技能和命令显示在下一级，长对话中展开的工具组保持展开。: The reading view groups each agent turn with its skills and commands beneath it, keeping tool groups expanded in long conversations.
消息排队和送达状态更可靠，从终端提交的排队消息也能在阅读视图中查看。: Queued messages and delivery status are more reliable, including messages queued from the terminal.
自动保存会继续保存写入期间的新修改，大文件分段编辑保留原有换行符，文件弹窗支持翻: Autosave follows up on edits made during a save, paged edits preserve line endings, and file popups support page navigation.
远程 Claude 会话正确恢复，跨目录的同名文件可以一起复制，已查看的完成提醒: Remote Claude sessions restore correctly, same-named files from different folders can be copied together, and background callbacks no longer rearm acknowledged completion alerts.
文件树图标按文件类型和目录用途区分颜色，单色主题继续使用统一墨色。: File-tree icons distinguish file types and folder purposes with color while monochrome themes keep a uniform ink.
阅读视图按回合分层，技能和命令显示在下一级，GPT/Codex 和 Claude: The reading view groups agent turns with nested skills and commands, official GPT/Codex and Claude marks, and stable expanded tools in long conversations.
Slash 指令即时显示执行状态，慢响应提供终端恢复入口，终端排队消息也能正确显: Slash commands show their status immediately, slow responses offer terminal recovery, and messages queued from the terminal remain visible.
剩余重置次数由后端自动查询并刷新，任务卡片保留正在处理状态，移除无意义的进度条。: Remaining reset counts refresh automatically in the background; task cards keep their processing status without meaningless progress bars.
本地 Codex 的剩余重置次数由后端自动查询并刷新，任务卡片保留正在处理状态，: Local Codex reset counts refresh automatically in the background; task cards keep their processing status without meaningless progress bars.

模型路由列出每个调用的模型担任什么角色、在处理什么任务，以及正在准备、运行中还是: The model route lists each called model's role, its task and whether it is preparing, running or being reviewed, and drops it once reviewed. Active tasks now sit right below the model route.

阅读视图里斜杠命令打开的终端改成输入框上方的小窗口，上面的对话仍然看得见。: The terminal a slash command opens in the reading view is now a small window above the message box, so the conversation stays in view.
